From: Tessa Morgan <tessa@redwood.com>

Date: 2027-07-18T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: QBR Preflight: Runway consolidation + account playbooks (action items)

Team —

We have the QBR on July 29. I want to lock the forecast and one-pager playbooks by COB Friday (7/23) so the leadership deck can be finalized on Monday. Please do the following for any deals you own in the top-of-book: 

1) Upload a one-page playbook for each named account (one-pager template attached): current ask, close plan, key blockers, any outstanding legal/compliance asks.
2) Confirm the forecast number in the consolidated spreadsheet (link TBD) and add any contingent/commit notes inline.
3) Flag any accounts where we need a security/compliance escalation — I will loop in Solutions Security if needed.

Narrow focus: Sigma Retail (opportunity: DEAL-4832), Orion Media, Apollo Finance. If you are not owner, please cc the AM who is. 

Attachments: qbr_playbook_template.docx

Thanks — please include a 1-line ETA when you reply so I can track.

—
Tessa Morgan
Head of Sales, Redwood Inference

Thanks, will do. Quick account notes below (ETA EOD Thu for one-pagers, EOD Fri for forecast lock):

Sigma Retail (DEAL-4832) — account owner: Marcus Lin. Current ask: POC + pilot for stores (50 stores) at $120k ARR. Close plan: executive review w/ procurement on 7/26, pilot statement delivered. Blockers: SOC 2 evidence outstanding; procurement wants a 90-day data retention commitment. Security questionnaire being completed by Marissa (cc).

Orion Media — account owner: Laura Bennett. Ask: embed LLM summarization into editorial workflow; ramp commitment expected in Q4. Risk: legal redlines on data usage.

Apollo Finance — account owner: Ben Carter. Ask: private deployment (VPC) hold pending security checklist sign-off; likely closed in Q4 if checklist completed.

I attached the Sigma one-pager I started (sigma_onepager_v2.pdf) — will iterate with Marissa on the security section.

Quick update on the consolidated forecast spreadsheet — I uploaded a working copy here: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1A2b3CqBRUNWAY_PREP (please bookmark). HubSpot record: HS-4832.

Forecast rules I used (please flag disagreements):
- Only include deals with verbal commitment or scheduled executive approval in Q3 as "commit".
- Contingent = legal/procurement open items > 7 days from expected close.
- Upside = early-stage pipeline with no scheduled exec approval.

Current consolidated numbers (high level): Q3 commit: $2.1M, contingent: $700k, upside: $1.4M. These are working numbers — final lock required by 7/23 COB.

I also added a column for "security blockers" so we can filter accounts that need escalation. Marcus: I pinned Sigma under contingent until SOC 2 artifacts come through (see note).

Laura Bennett
VP, Sales Ops, Redwood Inference

Adding the security perspective for Sigma Retail — attaching the filled questionnaire and a short risk note. Key points: 

- SOC 2: we can provide scoping artifacts this week but full report will take 4–6 weeks.
- Data retention request (90 days) is higher than our standard default for pilots; ops can scope a limited retention window for the pilot with redaction and tokenization to mitigate risk.
- Procurement is asking for a data processing addendum (DPA) amendment — legal will need to review.

Attachment: sigma_security_questionnaire.pdf

Action for Marcus: share the procurement contact and any expected exec attendees for 7/26 so I can prep the security summary slide.

- Sigma security brief (Marissa): short slide for leadership (due 7/26 morning) and escalate DPA ask to Legal (cc: Legal). (Owner: Marissa)

- Customer prep (Vivek): confirm which customers we want on the call during the QBR and get permission; target list by 7/24. (Owner: Vivek)
